items.title: S&P cuts Salesforce to ’A’ on rising acquisition debt and buybacks
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings downgraded Salesforce Inc (NYSE:CRM) to 'A' from 'A+', pointing to an increasingly aggressive capital allocation strategy characterized by debt-funded shareholder returns and large-scale acquisitions. The ratings agency highlighted that recent dealmaking, alongside a $25 billion debt-financed share repurchase program, has pushed pro forma net debt-to-EBITDA above its previous 2x downgrade threshold.
